name: Double Door Buddy
summary: Right-click one half of a double door and its twin swings open or shut too, so you walk through wide entrances in one click.
logoPrompt: A single pair of wooden double doors standing side by side and swinging open together, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Open one door, its partner follows.

description: **Double Door Buddy opens and closes both doors of a double door with a single right-click.**
- Click either door, top or bottom half, and the door next to it moves along.
- Pairs only real double doors: two doors of the same type, facing the same way, with mirrored hinges.
- The second door copies the state of the first, so a pair that got out of step lines up again.
- Each door plays its own opening or closing sound.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Place two doors side by side as usual and right-click one of them. Sneak with an empty hand to open only the door you click.
- Made for Fabric Loader on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Iron doors and redstone behave as in the base game; only your own click moves both doors.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
